notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Palinchron
When Izzet Chronarch and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
